# Camp Resource: Rocker Box

- 2 min read

__Rocker Box__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a1dc5cf61d854082b88a21f978702b31~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_cc4258c9d9e14685ab4fb72aed567dd3~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: SugarBombRADS

*"Why pan for resources when this Rocker Box can do it for you?"*

__Overview__

## **__Function__**

__Function__

Produces Scrap

| **Item Name** | **Drop Rate** | 
| Copper Scrap | 16.67% | 
| Crystal Scrap | 16.67% | 
| Gold Scrap | 16.67% | 
| Plastic Scrap | 16.67% | 
| Silver Scrap | 16.67% | 
| Ultracite Scrap | 16.67% | 

- Production Rate: 1 item every 10 minutes and 12 seconds
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: Yes

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 1

__Crafting Requirements__

- 5x Wood

__Capacity__

- Storage: Holds up to 1 pound of mixed scrap

## **__How to Unlock__**

__How to Unlock__

- Atom Shop: 
 - Rocker Box: X Atoms
 - Bundle: X Atoms (includes Rocker Box)
- Tradeable: No
- Giftable: No

Related Links:

__Build Restrictions__

- Shares Build Limit With: None
- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)

I'm an Aussie data miner who creates guides for farming, events, and food buffs in Fallout 76.

I firmly believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so my guides will always be free. However, maintaining a website and using photo and video editing software can be costly.
